full_prompt_en: A square ornamental storybook illustration places two large cartoon mice beside a smiling golden celestial face in a densely decorated garden. The round yellow face occupies the upper centre, with closed curved eyes, raised cheeks and a broad open grin. Its mottled gold surface is surrounded by tiny flowers, leaves, curling forms and scattered miniature figures. On the left, a pale grey mouse leans inward with large rounded ears, an elongated muzzle, a bright pink round nose and an open smiling mouth. It wears dark clothing with a light collar. On the right, another large mouse faces inward, its peach-pink ears and long muzzle framing a darker open mouth. Yellow hands and warm red-brown clothing stand out beneath its head. The two mice are substantial foreground figures rather than small background animals, and their faces turn towards the central golden disc. Below them, a narrow blue-green winding channel passes through a miniature world of small plants, flowers and indistinct decorative figures. Tiny warm and cool marks fill almost every gap, while dark green-black pockets separate the larger silhouettes. An elaborate gold-toned border encloses the scene with scrolls and fine patterned lines. Circular medallions occupy the upper corners, and more round decorative insets appear near the lower corners. Cream, dusty rose, yellow, turquoise and muted green accents mingle across the aged, finely worked surface. Fine outlines and softly worn colour patches combine a collage-like density with readable cartoon expressions. The lighting is pictorial and even, with brighter areas concentrated on the golden face, pale muzzles and pink noses rather than a single realistic light source. The nearly balanced arrangement of the two mice and central disc anchors the intricate border and crowded garden in a playful, fantastical composition.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形装饰性绘本插画，两只大卡通老鼠围在金色天体笑脸旁，下方是装饰密集的花园。圆形黄色面孔位于上方中央，弧形双眼闭合，脸颊隆起，嘴巴大大咧开。斑驳金色表面周围环绕着细小花叶、卷曲形态与零星微型角色。左侧浅灰老鼠向内探身，圆耳宽大，口鼻修长，亮粉圆鼻子与张开的笑嘴清楚可见，身穿带浅色领口的深色衣服。右侧另一只大老鼠朝内，桃粉耳朵与长口鼻围着深色张嘴，头部下方露出黄色手掌和暖红棕衣物。两只老鼠都是显著的前景角色，面向中央金色圆盘，并非背景小动物。它们下方，一道狭窄蓝绿色弯曲水道穿过微型植物、花朵和难以逐一辨清的装饰角色。冷暖小笔痕几乎填满所有空隙，深绿黑色空处则分隔较大的剪影。繁复金色边框以卷纹和纤细图案线围住画面，上方两角有圆形饰章，下方两角附近也嵌着圆形装饰。奶油白、灰玫瑰、黄色、青绿和柔和绿调交织在细密而有旧感的表面。纤细描边与轻微磨损色块将拼贴般密度和清楚卡通表情结合起来。光线均匀而偏绘画性，亮部集中于金色笑脸、浅色口鼻和粉色鼻子，没有单一写实光源。两只老鼠与中央圆盘近乎平衡的组织稳住精细边框及拥挤花园，构成俏皮奇幻的画面。
style_prompt_en: The style is ornamental and finely patterned, combining clear illustrated shapes with delicate linework. Deep blue-green grounds support warm gold, cream, dusty pink, and muted lavender accents. Small repeated marks build dense surface rhythm, while larger rounded shapes keep the design legible. Thin borders and corner motifs frame the central field. Light is even and gentle, so depth comes from overlap, scale, and colour rather than strong shadow. The composition favours near symmetry and a richly detailed perimeter around a clear central focal area.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格具有装饰性和细密图案感，将清晰插画形体与纤细线描结合起来。深蓝绿色底面衬托暖金、奶油白、灰粉和柔和薰衣草色。重复的小笔形建立浓密表面节奏，较大的圆润形状则维持整体辨识度。细边框与角落图案围住中央区域。光线均匀柔和，纵深来自遮叠、尺度和色彩，而非强烈投影。构图偏向近乎对称的组织，并在明确的中央焦点周围安排繁密细节。
theme_en: Two large cartoon mice beside a smiling golden celestial face
theme_zh: 两只大卡通老鼠与金色天体笑脸
name: Sally Cruikshank
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
